status: Experimental Rust cross-block list typing qualified; deletion, formatting, durable lists and browser integration remain incomplete

contracts.action: InsertFlatListTextAction with unchanged bounded InsertTextInput contract
contracts.operation: FlatListTextSplice for same-block input; one FlatListTextReplace for cross-block input
contracts.kindAndContainer: Spatial start block kind/rank and container family retained; prefix, insertion and endpoint suffix form one block
contracts.sameList: Original start retained; subsequent ordinals adjust to resulting item count
contracts.differentRoots: Fully selected middle roots removed; untouched start-prefix items retained; untouched endpoint-list suffix remains separate at its original first ordinal; no implicit merge or restart
contracts.formats: First spatially selected run, including middle items/roots; if selected text is empty, surviving left seam then right seam then plain text; unselected outside items excluded
contracts.selection: Before-affinity caret after insertion, pending formats consumed, exact original directional selection on undo
contracts.history: Existing typing merge group; following same-block typing can join the structural replacement history event
contracts.admission: Operation budget before planning; complete atomic result preview includes node, item, text-leaf and total-text limits
contracts.failure: Disabled typing preserves state and existing redo; stale prepared replacement rejects without overwriting later typing
contracts.scope: Separate flat-list capture and layout helpers; direct-root-only APIs, browser registrations and existing wire formats unchanged
